rationales.quote: I saw the flames, and I saw it going down
rationales.explanation: Howie characterizes the pitch's opening delivery as failing badly.

rationales.quote: are you selling your API to Instagram?
rationales.explanation: Howie asks how the company plans to commercialize and distribute its API through major platforms.

rationales.quote: Is it a licensing type of deal? I mean, you said a partnership. What does a partnership mean?
rationales.explanation: Howie seeks clarification on the commercial structure of the partnership.

rationales.quote: Sponsored posts are the only source of monetization?
rationales.explanation: Howie questions whether the proposed monetization model is limited to sponsored posts and probes licensing revenue.

rationales.quote: AR seems to be more on the path with some market viability.
rationales.explanation: Howie views AR as having better current market viability than heavily hyped VR.

rationales.quote: this is a great time to invest in this type of sector
rationales.explanation: Howie explicitly presents the sector's timing as favorable for investment.

rationales.quote: Do you have partnerships on that?
rationales.explanation: Howie asks whether the company has partnerships supporting practical AR/VR distribution.

rationales.quote: That is the new normal.
rationales.explanation: Howie characterizes immersive filters and transformed identities as normalized consumer behavior.

rationales.quote: I don't know how big the upside is
rationales.explanation: Uncertainty about the opportunity's potential upside contributes to Howie's decision not to invest in the current round.

rationales.quote: have more metrics to really understand how people are engaging, are they re-engaging
rationales.explanation: Howie wants stronger engagement and repeat-use metrics before evaluating the company.

rationales.quote: I really like you
rationales.explanation: Howie expresses a positive personal assessment of Sophia.

rationales.quote: I like this
rationales.explanation: Howie states that he personally likes the product and opportunity.

rationales.quote: I don't want to miss the boat on this
rationales.explanation: Howie's prior regret about passing on Snapchat makes him more reluctant to overlook SVRF.

rationales.quote: And then she completely turned it around.
rationales.explanation: Howie credits Sophia with recovering from the poor start and improving the pitch.

rationales.quote: I was so pleasantly surprised.
rationales.explanation: Howie reports a strongly positive reaction to Sophia's performance.

rationales.quote: Because that's going to be a big, that's a big market.
rationales.explanation: Howie sees AR as addressing a large market.

rationales.quote: What’s the valuation of Giphy? Does anyone know? Today?
rationales.explanation: Howie seeks a valuation benchmark for a comparable immersive-content search company.

rationales.quote: which is a good thing for investment
rationales.explanation: Howie explains that the sector's post-hype correction creates a favorable investment window.

rationales.quote: I can get great prices into
rationales.explanation: Howie views the corrected market as offering attractive entry prices.

rationales.quote: going to be built in a more sustainable manner
rationales.explanation: Howie believes the sector is entering a more sustainable development phase.

rationales.quote: SVRF is at the forefront of that
rationales.explanation: Howie positions SVRF as an early leader in the sector's more sustainable phase.

rationales.quote: it has never existed in the way that it’s existing now
rationales.explanation: Howie sees current technological maturity as making the category newly viable.

rationales.quote: I mean this is, this is a whole new world.
rationales.explanation: Howie describes the current immersive-content product category as novel and distinct.

rationales.quote: then it starts to grow more incrementally and more sustainably
rationales.explanation: Howie uses the hype-cycle framework to argue that the category is entering sustainable growth.

rationales.quote: a lot of technologies have to go through this cycle
rationales.explanation: Howie reiterates his view that the sector's correction is a normal step toward maturation.

rationales.quote: AR/VR is on the upward slope of enlightenment right now
rationales.explanation: Howie believes AR/VR has moved into a favorable maturation phase.

rationales.quote: It’s a new way for us to consume and, you know, dive into these worlds
rationales.explanation: Howie sees immersive media as an emerging consumer behavior enabled by current platforms.

rationales.quote: we don’t just invest in ideas and speculation, we invest in executions
rationales.explanation: Howie states that execution, rather than an unbuilt idea, is central to his investment approach.

rationales.quote: we have conviction that SVRF is going to be the search engine for immersives
rationales.explanation: Howie expresses conviction that SVRF can become the category-defining search layer for immersive content.

question is queried/neutral, not a negative belief. Greetings, jokes, biography, simple confirmations and bare In/Out without
a reason are not rationales. Distinguish closely related taxonomy definitions; do not add broad redundant labels.
Retain each distinct rationale-bearing target utterance and exact evidence turn. Multiple labels on a turn are allowed only
when distinct concepts are expressed. For a repeated concept in different substantive turns retain each occurrence.
Quotes must be exact nonempty substrings of that turn's attributed_text, never continuation narration or another speaker.
The full text is included for context, but only attributed_text is eligible quote evidence.
Classify timing: original_pitch includes Q&A AND the entire original in-room decision discussion; later_commentary includes
post-pitch interviews, later diligence and subsequent updates; teaser is an opening preview/repeated future clip. Use unclear
when timing is uncertain. Do not use the redacted input cutoff as the end of original in-room discussion. Same-session
reversals stay original_pitch. Immediate investor-only debrief in the same room after the founder exits also stays
original_pitch; it is NOT later_commentary. Reserve later_commentary for separate interviews, diligence or updates. Do not mix retrospective opinions into original-pitch scoring.
Direction is positive/negative/neutral towards investing in this company. Salience primary means a stated major reason, not
merely any question. decision_link supports_in/out ONLY if the target links the rationale to the commitment/refusal.
Confidence concerns the annotation, not investment probability. Return reviewed_target_turns containing EVERY supplied target
turn index exactly once, even when it contains no rationale. An empty rationale list is valid if none was expressed.
Be concise: prefer one short exact quote per distinct concept/turn, and a one-sentence explanation. Never claim human validation.

rationales.explanation: Howie characterizes the pitch's opening delivery as failing badly.

rationales.explanation: Howie notes that major platforms already provide related functionality, raising the question of SVRF's distinct role.

rationales.explanation: Howie asks whether major social platforms are customers for SVRF's API.

rationales.quote: Give me an example.
rationales.explanation: In context, Howie asks for a concrete example of an API distribution partnership.

rationales.quote: Is it a licensing type of deal?
rationales.explanation: Howie probes whether the partnership has a licensing-based commercial structure.

rationales.quote: Sponsored posts are the only source of monetization?
rationales.explanation: Howie questions the reliance on sponsored posts and probes whether licensing could provide another revenue stream.

rationales.quote: AR seems to be more on the path with some market viability.
rationales.explanation: Howie believes AR is showing greater current market viability than VR.

rationales.quote: this is a great time to invest in this type of sector
rationales.explanation: Howie explicitly argues that the sector is at a favorable point for investment.

rationales.quote: can you talk about any of the exciting things of how this content could be practically applied or implemented through AR/VR?
rationales.explanation: Howie asks about practical ways the content can be implemented through AR and VR.

rationales.quote: Do you have partnerships on that?
rationales.explanation: Howie asks whether partnerships support the company's path into practical AR and VR applications.

rationales.quote: That is the new normal.
rationales.explanation: Howie characterizes the use of transformed identities and immersive filters as normalized consumer behavior.

rationales.quote: I don't know how big the upside is
rationales.explanation: Howie's uncertainty about the potential return is a major reason not to invest in the current round.

rationales.quote: I usually like to swim in the post-seed waters; probably the round that would be coming after this.
rationales.explanation: Howie explains that his preferred investment stage is later than SVRF's current round.

rationales.quote: have more metrics to really understand how people are engaging, are they re-engaging
rationales.explanation: Howie wants stronger evidence of engagement and repeat usage before investing.

rationales.quote: I really like you
rationales.explanation: Howie expresses a positive personal assessment of Sophia despite declining the current round.

rationales.quote: I like this.
rationales.explanation: Howie states that the product and opportunity appeal to him.

rationales.quote: I don't want to miss the boat on this
rationales.explanation: Howie's imagined regret about passing on Snapchat makes him wary of overlooking another generational shift.

rationales.quote: And then she completely turned it around.
rationales.explanation: Howie credits Sophia with recovering successfully from the pitch's poor opening.

rationales.quote: Because that's going to be a big, that's a big market.
rationales.explanation: Howie argues that AR should remain prominent in the pitch because it represents a large market.

rationales.quote: What’s the valuation of Giphy?
rationales.explanation: Howie seeks the valuation of a comparable content-search company as a benchmark for SVRF's potential upside.

rationales.quote: it is at a low uh point, which is a good thing for investment
rationales.explanation: Howie explains that the sector's post-hype low creates a favorable investment window.

rationales.quote: I can get great prices into
rationales.explanation: Howie views the market correction as allowing investments at attractive entry prices.

rationales.quote: going to be built in a more sustainable manner
rationales.explanation: Howie believes AR and VR are entering a more sustainable phase after the earlier hype and correction.

rationales.quote: SVRF is at the forefront of that
rationales.explanation: Howie views SVRF as an early leader in the sector's more sustainable development phase.

rationales.quote: it’s become more mature
rationales.explanation: Howie believes immersive technology has matured into a substantially more developed category.

rationales.quote: then it starts to grow um more incrementally and more sustainably
rationales.explanation: Howie uses the hype-cycle framework to argue that a post-correction technology can enter sustainable growth.

rationales.quote: a lot of, a lot of technologies have to go through this cycle
rationales.explanation: Howie argues that the category's boom-and-correction cycle is a normal part of technological maturation.

rationales.quote: AR/VR is, is on the upward slope of enlightenment right now
rationales.explanation: Howie believes AR and VR have moved into a favorable phase of renewed, sustainable development.

rationales.quote: It’s a new way for us to consume and, you know, dive into these worlds
rationales.explanation: Howie sees smartphone-enabled immersive media as an emerging form of consumer experience.

rationales.quote: we don’t just invest in ideas and speculation, we invest in executions
rationales.explanation: Howie explains that SVRF's demonstrated execution, rather than a merely speculative idea, drove the investment.

rationales.quote: we have conviction that SVRF is going to be the search engine for immersives
rationales.explanation: Howie believes SVRF can become the category-defining search platform for immersive content.
